_README: Provenance for the league-scored baseline projection CSVs in this directory.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS: a Sleeper projection is only meaningful alongside the scoring
settings that produced it. The same defense is a 111-point season under the settings
below and a 276-point season under CBS's assumptions -- and it is the SPREAD, not the
level, that VOR reads as positional separation. Committing the points without the rules
that generated them would leave the numbers unfalsifiable.
THIS IS DOCUMENTATION, NOT A SCORING INPUT. Nothing reads this file at runtime. The
stat-category keys below are inferred from Sleeper's public vocabulary to make a future
live comparison easier, but they have NOT been verified against a real get_league()
payload from this environment (api.sleeper.app is not reachable here). Verify them
against a live payload before wiring this into any scoring path -- a wrong key scores
silently as zero, which is exactly the class of error the rest of this pipeline refuses
KNOWN GAP: the two CSVs come from two DIFFERENT leagues (see below). Both are redraft,
and their K and DEF point ranges are closely comparable (K 116-22, DEF 111-81), but
'comparable range' is not 'same rulebook'. Regenerating both positions from ONE league
via sleeper_client.build_baseline_projection_rows is the fix once a live connection is
